title: Communication dated 22 July 2022 received from the Permanent Mission of the Russian Federation to the Agency
text:
Information Circular 
 
INFCIRC/1010 
Date: 25 July 2022 
General Distribution 
Original: English, Russian 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Communication dated 22 July 2022 received 
from the Permanent Mission of the Russian 
Federation to the Agency 
 
 
 
1. 
The Secretariat has received a Note Verbale dated 22 July 2022 from the Permanent Mission of 
the Russian Federation to the Agency. 
2. 
As requested, the Note Verbale is herewith circulated for the information of all Member States. 
 
 
 
 
Atoms for Peace and Development 

INFCIRC/1010 
Attachment

2 
In recent days, Kiev has carried out such provocations with frightening 
frequency - the last time a similar attack on the ZNPP using UAVs was carried out 
on July 18. The curators of the V.Zelensky regime prefer not to notice such actions 
of the Ukrainian military against nuclear infrastructure, encouraging them to 
continue their attacks. 
We call on international organizations and the world community to pay close 
attention to the situation around Ukrainian nuclear facilities. It is necessary to make 
every effort to force Ukraine to stop the criminal practice of shelling nuclear power 
plants, which can lead to the most unpredictable and grave consequences. 
The Permanent Mission of the Russian Federation requests the Secretariat to 
circulate this information among all IAEA Member States as soon as possible. 
The Permanent Mission of the Russian Federation avails itself of this 
opportunity to renew to the IAEA Secretariat the assurances of its highest 
consideration. 
Vienna, 'W-0' July 2022
